description: An export guide replaces actionable steps with unexplained conversation shorthand.
requirements: Shorten the CSV export guide while keeping it usable by a new user who did not take part in the discussion.

expected.summary: The guide replaces the Settings, Account and Export steps with undefined gate, D2 and usual scope references from a discussion. A new reader cannot determine what to open or select to export CSV; this breaks writing principles 2 and 3.
